summary: Aurora representative with 16 principal-authored bills centered on public health provision (free annual check-ups, specialty hospitals, health-worker Magna Carta), teacher salary-grade upgrades and local roads. Co-authored the national minimum wage. No social-values, civil-liberties or institutions evidence found.
caveat: Only economic evidence; state-funded health and pay bills are consistent with left lean but are not alone decisive. Bill-list evidence only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Universal free annual check-ups and satellite specialty hospitals (-3); pay upgrades and Magna Cartas for teachers and health workers (-2); co-authored national minimum wage (-2, discounted). No tax or privatization evidence.
